nodes.asset_description: Full-canvas collage composed of nine outdoor fashion photographs separated by thin white gutters. The images feature two people in bright midday sunlight on a modern urban sidewalk with concrete walls, glass windows, and repeating metal awnings casting linear shadows. The subjects wear mostly white outfits: a woman in a white ribbed racerback crop tank and cream high-waisted wide-leg pants, and another person in a short-sleeve white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves and light shorts. Both wear light beige/cream rectangular sunglasses. The collage includes: a close-up head-and-shoulders portrait with sunglasses (top left), a large central vertical image of both standing under the awning (top-middle), a close-up side view of a shoulder and tank strap (top right), a seated three-quarter shot with sunglasses (mid-left), a diagonal overhead shot of the person in the button-up shirt reclining on pavement (mid-right), a bottom-left wide shot of both standing under the awning from farther back, a bottom-center tight crop of torsos showing the tank and button-up, and other medium/full-body views. Color palette is warm neutrals with soft teal/gray architecture and hard-edged shadows; high contrast, crisp focus.
